title: Lemon Sorbet (Lemon Water Ice)
changes_from_base: Whole lemon flesh blended and sieved instead of mango and lime, with more water and sugar and a little zest; no corn syrup, so it is icier, like a water ice.
summary: Whole lemon flesh blended with sugar and water, sieved and churned into a sharp, refreshing lemon sorbet in the style of a water ice.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Chill the tin
steps.text: Put the loaf tin in the freezer so the sorbet does not melt when it goes in.

steps.title: Zest
steps.text: Finely grate 1 tsp of zest from one lemon and set it aside.

steps.title: Prepare the lemons
steps.text: With the sharp knife cut away the peel and all the white pith. Chop the flesh and remove the seeds; you need about 700 ml of chopped fruit.

steps.title: Blend and sieve
steps.text: Process the lemon flesh with 120 ml of the water, the sugar and salt for about 1 min until very smooth. Pour through the sieve into the jug, pressing hard on the solids, then stir in the remaining 360 ml water. Chill until cold.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 15-25 min until it looks like grainy soft serve. Add the zest during the last minute.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Spread in the cold tin, cover and freeze for at least 1 h. If it is too hard to scoop, leave it for 5-10 min first.

tips: Remove every bit of white pith; it makes the sorbet bitter.
Unwaxed lemons are best when you use the zest.
Serve between courses or with fresh berries.
storage: Keep frozen and covered for up to 1 month.
